title: Creation wizard: level-1 spell step does not validate cantrip/spell counts or wizard preparation
description: Found in eshyra-nnj6.1. Creation writes structured spellcasting buckets from the free-form draft spells list (classified by effectiveSpellcasting), but neither the draft nor the wizard enforces the class cantrip/spell/spellbook counts (class.cantrips / class.spells choices are enumerated but not gated), and wizard prepared spells are not collected at creation. Level-up then works from whatever was chosen.
